objective: CE response at final position + 0.1 CE two bindings at initial-memory stage; NO post-stage auxiliary loss
control: literal original 160 records, original random.Random(seed).randrange(160) indices
treatment: 50% correction variants by fixed (step*8+slot)%12; same base indices; both corrected roles, all three nonzero deltas
paired_exposure: one answer and two initial auxiliary targets per record; equal 2400 responses and 4800 auxiliary targets per arm; correction events differ necessarily
confirmation: only if all primary treatment thresholds pass; paired A/B seeds29 and43, same 300 updates; different historical seed-specific warmstarts plus new module seeds707+(seed-17) and decoder101+(seed-17); no sealed evaluation
position_arm: after main closed and weight-frozen grid; if main has a >=10pp position-grid spread or layout error >=10%, allow ONE P seed17 300-update data-only comparison against B; initial pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5), correction positions6,8,10; no architectural/loss changes
position_evaluation: new initial(6,7), correction11; unavailable to training; evaluate only after P final
sealed: new family generated/hashed at freeze, no model evaluation or text inspection
selection: final step300 only, no checkpoint or hyperparameter selection by dev; no early stopping except mechanical NaN/contract failure
evaluation_separation: correction_fit is training-fit diagnostic, excluded from independent gates; correction_fixed uses unseen entity pair distance2; all other gate families have zero train overlap
